keyFindings.description: Under the records' daemon an issue in held gets the removal push. GET /legion/v1/state reports phase held with no hold origin (api/state.go:265-293); claimFailed holds an issue from testing, reviewing or merging (engine.go:689-690). A hold from testing loses its planned red (ApplyPush sets PlannedRed from the implement App's push), so the retry's standingRed sends it to implementing; a hold from reviewing leaves an approval of an uncompleted round; a hold from awaiting_merge disarms and the retry restores a READY naming a head the branch no longer has. Defer held too (or expose the hold's origin), test it, and re-read the issue's phase just before the removal so an issue that moved into a deferred phase during the run is not pushed.

merging is deferred for a reason that holds only for awaiting_merge: in merging headMoved only voids a READY the design gate holds (workflow/ready.go:161-202) and keeps phase and approval, and the new READY lets the removal through. Deferring merging makes another issue's .legion/ directory reach the default branch, failing A9's first clause where removing meets all of A9. Remove in merging (with a test), or keep the deferral and state its real cost; either way correct the reason at docs/kubernetes.md:5245 and :5284 and handoffimport.go:308-317.
